purpose: Independent synthetic U3 meaning reserve frozen after named-recipient repairs. Once run, mark it exposed and do not tune while continuing to call it held out.
evaluationOrder: Freeze corpus bytes and global meaning rubric before production request export and generation. Separate generation, policy readiness, and semantic review.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: A draft or safe recovery preserves recipient, dates, names, amounts, units, URL/path/flag bytes, negation, uncertainty, correction, condition, and action boundary. Paraphrases may change wording without changing these meanings.
semanticCriteria.critical: Missing or changed recipient or factual value; lost negation, uncertainty, conditional limit, exact technical literal; fabricated completion or send claim; unsupported content reaches review.
semanticCriteria.minor: Stylistic awkwardness or extra wording without meaning change.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 20 cases have zero critical meaning errors and zero deterministic exact-literal violations. Safe rejection is recorded separately from a successful draft.
